# hermes_custom_provider (Resource)

Manages a named, non-secret Hermes custom model provider. Credentials remain outside Terraform/OpenTofu state and should be injected into Hermes through an external secret manager.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL, such as `http://llm.example.com:8000/v1`.
- `model` (String) Default model identifier served by the endpoint.
- `name` (String) Display name for the provider entry. The stable remote key is derived from the name at creation.
- `profile` (String) Lowercase Hermes profile that owns the provider entry. Use `default` explicitly when intended.

### Optional

- `discover_models` (Boolean) Whether Hermes may discover models from the endpoint.

### Read-Only

- `context_length` (Number) Context length reported or configured by Hermes. This is read-only until Hermes exposes a lossless clear/update contract.
- `has_api_key` (Boolean) Whether Hermes has a credential reference for this endpoint; the value is never returned.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_current` (Boolean)
- `models` (List of String) Models discovered or configured for this endpoint.
- `source` (String)
